install.extra_for_harness: npm i pixelmatch@7.1.0 pngjs@7.0.0 (0.5 s, +1 MB; only for the parity measurement, not needed at build time)
install.windows: yes: pure JavaScript, Node >= 16, no native modules; the CLI (svgo.cmd shim) and svgo.config.mjs work unchanged on Windows. The raster harness needs Playwright Chromium, also fine on Windows but not part of the build step.

fixtures: fixtures/06-svgo/in: 10 synthetic SVGs (3 icons 24x24; a11y logo with title/desc/role/aria-labelledby; badge with <style> #ids + <use href>; gradient url(#id); clipPath+mask; SMIL + CSS @keyframes spinner; text with font-family; Inkscape/Illustrator cruft). KEY.json seeds 58 preservation requirements (viewBox, ids, role/aria, title/desc, style/animation/text/font); the originals pass all of them (baseline-check.json).

candidate_default.config: svgo preset-default, no config file (`svgo -f in -o out`)
commands: node raster.mjs fixtures/06-svgo/in out-default out-tuned png
candidate_default.breakage_severity: 1 hard accessibility break (logo: role=img removed by removeUnknownsAndDefaults keepRoleAttr=false; cleanupIds renames the title/desc ids but does not rewrite aria-labelledby, which now points at nothing). 11 hook breaks: ids referenced only by <style>/url()/href are minified or removed after inlineStyles, so site CSS/JS that targets #accent, #pulse, #brandGradient stops working. Pixels unchanged in every case.

candidate_tuned.config: fixtures/06-svgo/svgo.config.mjs: preset-default with multipass; removeDesc, cleanupIds, inlineStyles, minifyStyles, removeHiddenElems off; removeUnknownsAndDefaults {keepRoleAttr:true, keepAriaAttrs:true}. (removeViewBox/removeTitle are not in preset-default in svgo 4; overriding them there is an error.)
commands: node raster.mjs fixtures/06-svgo/in out-default out-tuned png

parity_method: Each SVG inlined in an HTML page, CSS width 512px (height from viewBox), headless Chromium screenshot, pixelmatch threshold 0.1. Animated spinner: SMIL paused + setCurrentTime and Web Animations paused + currentTime, compared at t=0 and t=400 ms. Harness controls: original t=0 vs t=400 ms differ by 20.08 % (seek works); a recoloured/shifted icon-play differs from the original by 51.07 % (diff detects change).

wrapper.tested: tuned config: exit 0, 10/10 ok, output byte-identical to the CLI run; plain preset-default: exit 1, 5 files / 11 problems (same files the KEY check flags)

limits: Fixtures are synthetic (10 files, 9.4 KB total): written like the site's own icons, but not the site's real files; absolute savings on real logos will differ.

Pixel parity measured in Chromium only (one engine, one size, one font set); Firefox/Safari and /CSS-background embedding not tested. 0 % diff at threshold 0.1 is strict but not proof of identical rendering everywhere.
Animation parity is two frames (t=0, t=400 ms) with paused/seeked SMIL + CSS animations, not a full timeline comparison.
The tuned config gives up 5 points of raw saving (39.2 % vs 44.2 %) to keep ids, <style> and role/aria. Per-file savings 11-74 %; smallest on the a11y logo and the gradient.

svgo 4 preset-default no longer touches viewBox or <title>, but still drops role=img, renames/removes ids and inlines <style>; every default-config breakage is a configuration matter, not a bug. svgo cleanupIds does not treat aria-labelledby as an id reference.
Structural checks use the sax parser (an svgo dependency), not a full SVG DOM; the wrapper sketch uses regexes and assumes well-formed SVG with double-quoted attributes.
The wrapper sketch was run from a directory where `svgo` resolves (scratchpad); in the site repo it needs svgo in devDependencies.
editor-cruft.svg: the tuned config keeps the display:none guide layer (removeHiddenElems off, about 60 B); re-enable the plugin if hidden layers are never scripted.
reason: Tuned config: -39.2 % bytes (-31.3 % gzipped) across 10 files, 0 of 58 seeded requirements broken, 0.000 % pixel diff on every file and both animation frames, 0.47 s for 10 files, pure-JS MIT tool that runs on Windows. svgo defaults are NOT safe for this site: 12 breakages in 4 files including a real accessibility break on the logo. Adopt only with the tuned config plus the post-check wrapper, which turned the default-config breakages into exit 1 in testing.
